page.overview:
What is Tynamo?

Tynamo is a very small eel-like Pokémon. Its tiny body is white, with a yellow zigzagging pattern across its side. It has very small black eyes and a small slightly star-shaped mouth with four points. Tynamo's appearance is a bit like a triple cross-over of a tadpole, eel and a glassfish.

Tynamo live in large schools. Though technically amphibious, these Pokémon can live their lives either entirely on water, on land, or both with no ill effects. These Pokémon tend to congregate in damper areas where they can easily access water to keep themselves hydrated, and find strength in numbers; while individually weak, many Tynamo emitting their shocks together can create jolts as strong as bolts of lightning. When threatened, a school of Tynamo will ball tightly together so that any foes that attempt to attack will be met with discharged electricity from the entire group.

In some regions, the tiny shocks of electricity from a lone Tynamo were traditionally used to numb small regions of the body prior to invasive medical operations.

When not in the water, Tynamo levitate by generating weak electromagnetic forces beneath them. They have tiny organs that generates minute electrical charges they can use to shock foes, though the weak voltage fails to significantly hinder opponents.
